title: Preparing for interview success as a psychologist - DClinPsy - Assistant Psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了用时间换金钱以外的钱，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客在身边，你就在通往玛丽安·特伦特博士的《有抱负的心理学家》播客的路上了。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I am a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: So, if you are downloading this fairly recently to when it was released, which is in March 2023,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是在它发布后不久下载的，也就是2023年3月，

sentences.en: it probably hasn't escaped your knowledge that it is application notification season.
sentences.zh: 你可能已经知道现在是申请通知季了。

sentences.en: So, I am well aware that educational psychology interviews are already in full swing.
sentences.zh: 所以我很清楚，教育心理学的面试已经全面展开了。

sentences.en: So, if you are waiting to hear back on the outcome of one of those, or if you are awaiting attending one of those yourself, then wishing you all the very best of luck.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你正在等待其中一个面试结果，或者你自己正在等待参加面试，那么祝你好运。

sentences.en: And there might well be useful information in here for you as well.
sentences.zh: 这里面可能也有对你有用的信息。

sentences.en: But, of course, it is declinesci notification season currently.
sentences.zh: 当然，目前也是拒绝通知季。

sentences.en: We are on the verge of interview season.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于面试季的边缘。

sentences.en: So, just to recap some of those important dates, we know that by the 17th of March,
sentences.zh: 所以，回顾一下那些重要的日期，我们知道到3月17日，

sentences.en: Clearinghouse and the Associated Courses must have let applicants know whether or not they will be invited to an interview for this year or whether they've been placed on a reserve list for an interview this year.
sentences.zh: 清算所和相关课程必须通知申请人他们今年是否会被邀请参加面试，或者他们是否被列入了今年的面试候补名单。

sentences.en: It's always worth bearing in mind that if you are on the reserve list for an interview, you could be called even as soon as like that morning of the interview.
sentences.zh: 永远值得记住的是，如果你在面试候补名单上，你甚至可能在面试当天早上被叫去面试。

sentences.en: So, when it's interview week, make sure your outfit is clean, what you want to wear.
sentences.zh: 所以，当面试周到来时，确保你的衣服是干净的，是你想要穿的。

sentences.en: Make sure that, you know, you've perhaps let people know in your diary that you might already have booked in for meetings, supervision, appointments,
sentences.zh: 确保你可能已经在日记中告知了人们你可能已经预订了会议、督导、预约，

sentences.en: that you're hoping there may be a chance you're called to interview.
sentences.zh: 你希望有机会被叫去面试。

sentences.en: Because I really do believe in putting stuff out there in the universe.
sentences.zh: 因为我真的相信把事情投射到宇宙中。

sentences.en: If you're kind of paving the way for potentially having an interview during a set week, then tell the universe that that is what you'd welcome.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在为在特定的一周内可能进行的面试铺平道路，那就告诉宇宙这是你所欢迎的。

sentences.en: Don't be looking at your diary going, oh, God, which day should it be?
sentences.zh: 不要看着你的日记想，天哪，应该是哪一天？

sentences.en: Which day would I have to cancel?
sentences.zh: 我必须取消哪一天？

sentences.en: Or, you know, make sure that the people in each of your days know that, you know, you may have to cancel at short notice.
sentences.zh: 或者，确保你每一天的人都知道你可能需要在短时间内取消。

sentences.en: If you're already working for the NHS, it's also worth bearing in mind that in theory, you don't need to take a day's annual leave to be able to attend an NHS interview.
sentences.zh: 如果你已经在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）工作，也值得记住的是，理论上，你不需要请年假来参加NHS的面试。

sentences.en: Because, in essence, this is an NHS interview, you might then be able to keep your leave for something that feels a bit more restful.
sentences.zh: 因为本质上，这是一次NHS面试，你或许可以把假期留给一些感觉更放松的事情。

sentences.en: Because, you know, I was going to say, you keep your leave for something a bit more exciting.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我本来想说，你把假期留给一些更令人兴奋的事情。

sentences.en: But actually, I was really excited about both of the interview days that I had.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我对我的两次面试日都感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: You should be feeling, you know, a little bit, you're like, oh, this is a big deal.
sentences.zh: 你应该感到，你知道，有一点，你觉得，哦，这是一件大事。

sentences.en: But also excited that you get to showcase, you get to show why you're so ready for this opportunity.
sentences.zh: 但也为你能够展示自己，能够展示为什么你为这个机会做好了准备而感到兴奋。

sentences.en: And that's regardless of what you're going for an interview for, of course, you know, whatever job you're going for, it ought to feel exciting.
sentences.zh: 当然，无论你面试什么，无论你申请什么工作，这都应该让人感到兴奋。

sentences.en: You know, you ought to feel like you've got a reasonable chance and that it's something that you would want, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你应该觉得你有合理的机会，而且这是你想要的，你知道。

sentences.en: So make sure that's the case.
sentences.zh: 所以确保情况确实如此。

sentences.en: So try and make sure that you do at least feel some excitement.
sentences.zh: 所以尽量确保你至少感到一些兴奋。

sentences.en: It's not just abject horror.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是极度的恐惧。

sentences.en: So you may well be listening to this aware that perhaps your first or maybe even your first couple of courses that you've applied to have notified you that it is a no firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以你听这个的时候可能意识到，也许你申请的第一个甚至前几个课程已经通知你被拒绝了。

sentences.en: It's really hard and I'm really sorry.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难，我真的很抱歉。

sentences.en: I'm absolutely gutted for you.
sentences.zh: 我真的为你感到难过。

sentences.en: I also recall that the year that I was successful in getting on to training, I was actually told no first by the one course who weren't going to be offering me an interview.
sentences.zh: 我也记得我成功进入培训的那一年，我实际上首先被那个不打算给我面试机会的课程拒绝了。

sentences.en: So for those of you who don't know my story, I was offered interviews at three other courses,
sentences.zh: 所以对于那些不知道我故事的人，我获得了其他三个课程的面试机会，

sentences.en: but one of the courses cancelled the entire course just before I was due to attend my interview.
sentences.zh: 但其中一个课程在我准备参加面试前取消了整个课程。

sentences.en: So, yeah, if you go back into the annals of history, you'll see that the 2008 intake for the Bristol course didn't go ahead at all.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果你回到历史的年鉴中，你会看到布里斯托尔课程的2008年招生根本没有进行。

sentences.en: And then I think it actually moved to Plymouth ultimately.
sentences.zh: 然后我想它最终搬到了普利茅斯。

sentences.en: But yes, I was potentially part of that cohort if I'd been interviewed because I do wonder, I did really like Bristol.
sentences.zh: 但是的，如果我被面试了，我可能就是那批学生的一部分，因为我确实想知道，我真的很喜欢布里斯托尔。

sentences.en: I was telling one of my friends who lives in Bristol recently, I really like Bristol.
sentences.zh: 我最近告诉一个住在布里斯托尔的朋友，我真的很喜欢布里斯托尔。

sentences.en: I may have picked, I may have picked Bristol had they offered me a place, had that gone ahead.
sentences.zh: 如果他们给了我一个名额，如果那件事继续进行，我可能已经选择了布里斯托尔。

sentences.en: But I'm very, very pleased with where I did end up.
sentences.zh: 但我对我最终去的地方非常非常满意。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you're in a position where you do have multiple interviews at different courses, we have this sort of butterfly effect, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当你处于在不同课程有多次面试的位置时，我们有这种所谓的蝴蝶效应，你知道，

sentences.en: that it's quite a big decision which course you'll be at because it could potentially lead to what future job you'll be in,
sentences.zh: 你将在哪个课程学习是一个相当大的决定，因为它可能会导致你未来的工作，

sentences.en: who it will definitely lead to who your future supervisors will be, who your future cohort will be.
sentences.zh: 它肯定会导致你未来的督导是谁，你未来的同学是谁。

sentences.en: In my case, it led to the creation of two wonderful little boys and a marriage, you know, and friendship groups and in-laws and all of that jazz.
sentences.zh: 在我的情况下，它导致了两个可爱的男孩的出生和一段婚姻，你知道，还有朋友圈和姻亲等等。

sentences.en: So it is really can be a life changing decision, especially if you're doing that at an age point where you do have more choices, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以这确实可能是一个改变人生的决定，特别是如果你在有更多选择的年龄段做这件事，你知道，

sentences.en: where you could end up going to Scotland, you could end up going to Wales, you could end up going to the south of England or to middle England, you know.
sentences.zh: 你可以去苏格兰，你可以去威尔士，你可以去英格兰南部或英格兰中部，你知道。

sentences.en: So if you are more footloose and fancy free, then these decisions, the ones you say yes to or the ones who say yes to you can be life changing.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你更自由自在，那么这些决定，你说是的决定，或者他们对你说是的决定，都可能改变人生。

sentences.en: And that can be exciting, but can also be a little bit terrifying, too.
sentences.zh: 这可能令人兴奋，但也可能有点可怕。

sentences.en: So anyway, we're wandering off track, but I want to empathise with anybody who has so far received no or not yet, as we think about them.

sentences.zh: 那么你很可能会获得其他面试的候补名单名额，或者你也很可能会获得其他课程的直接面试邀请。

sentences.en: So I am sending you so much hope, so much, so many crossed fingers that that happens for you.

sentences.en: So, yeah, it could help you to think about how to use supervision and how to give effective clinical supervision too.

sentences.en: And, of course, we go on to the research section as well.

sentences.en: So that you are able to, you know,
sentences.zh: 这样你才能，你知道，

sentences.zh: 批判性地评估他人和自己的研究，思考研究知识库中的空白，以及你未来可能想要探索什么，或者你认为未来探索什么是有用的。

sentences.en: That might well be stuff from your own clinical population that you're working in.
sentences.zh: 这很可能来自你目前工作的临床人群。

sentences.en: That's OK.

sentences.en: But you need to have an overview of what research is already out there and be able to talk confidently about what stuff you think would be useful in future and how and why you might investigate it or put that together.
sentences.zh: 但你需要对现有的研究有一个概览，并能自信地谈论你认为未来哪些内容是有用的，以及你如何、为何去调查或整合这些内容。

sentences.en: So have a play around with that.
sentences.zh: 所以，试着去尝试一下吧。

sentences.en: And again, that's stuff that we do do in the membership and that you can catch up on as well.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这些是我们会员计划中会做的事情，你也可以补上这些内容。

sentences.en: So having a working knowledge of research methods is really useful.

sentences.en: You know, it's OK to turn towards that so that it's not such a weak Achilles heel for you so that it feels like you're strengthening your suit of armour to have fewer chinks in it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正视它也没关系，这样它就不会成为你致命的弱点，让你感觉像是在加固盔甲，减少缝隙。

sentences.en: And fewer, you know, fewer really spots that feel very tender, that if someone pokes it, you're not going to go too much so that you feel ready.
sentences.zh: 减少那些让你感觉非常敏感的地方，这样如果有人触碰它，你也不会反应过度，让你感到准备充分。

sentences.en: Why do we do it?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么要进行研究？

sentences.en: Why do we think it's useful?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们认为它有用？

sentences.en: Having your own individual stance on that can be really useful, too.

sentences.en: So professional issues as well.

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Voronita Kosova.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫Voronita Kosova。

sentences.en: I live in Edinburgh and I just graduated with a Master's in Psychology of Mental Health.
sentences.zh: 我住在爱丁堡，刚获得了心理健康心理学硕士学位。

sentences.en: Marion recommended me the Clinical Psychologist Collective when I was networking on LinkedIn and I must say I love it.
sentences.zh: 当我在LinkedIn上建立人脉时，Marion向我推荐了“临床心理学家集体”，我必须说我非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: It is one of a kind.
sentences.zh: 它是独一无二的。

sentences.en: It's like a window into the lives of people on the path of becoming a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 它就像一扇窗，让我们看到那些走在成为心理学家道路上的人们的生活。

sentences.en: The stories are unique, honest and filled with a kind of intangible wisdom only personal storytelling can uncover.
sentences.zh: 这些故事独特、诚实，充满了只有个人叙述才能揭示的那种无形的智慧。

sentences.en: A common thread in the stories I valued most was to be compassionate not only with others but with myself, too.
sentences.zh: 我最看重的故事中有一个共同点，那就是不仅要对他人的富有同情心，也要对自己富有同情心。

sentences.en: Also, not fixating on becoming a psychologist but enjoying life, growth and the final results will come as a byproduct.
sentences.zh: 此外，不要执着于成为一名心理学家，而是要享受生活、成长，最终的结果会作为副产品自然到来。

sentences.en: Marion, thank you for taking the time to collate all the stories.
sentences.zh: Marion，谢谢你花时间整理这些故事。

sentences.en: The book is a true gem and I think every aspiring psychologist should have a copy on their shelf.
sentences.zh: 这本书是一块真正的瑰宝，我认为每一位有抱负的心理学家都应该在书架上放一本。

sentences.en: any kind of qualified psychologist is really useful.
sentences.zh: 任何类型的合格心理学家都是非常有用的。

sentences.en: And it helps you get those tumbleweed moments out and they're done so that you feel less horrified.
sentences.zh: 这有助于你消除那些尴尬的时刻，这样你就不会感到那么惊慌了。

sentences.en: And it's also really useful to think about recording yourself.

sentences.en: Episode 10, well worth a listen because people find that really, really useful.
sentences.zh: 第10集，非常值得一听，因为人们发现这真的非常、非常有帮助。

sentences.zh: 所以，是的，听听你自己的声音。

sentences.en: Get used to the sound of you talking about you and knowing that's OK.
sentences.zh: 习惯听自己谈论自己，并知道这没关系。

sentences.en: you have been made aware that you have been given four no thanks, not yet, then please try not to lose hope.

sentences.en: This process does start again before we know it.

sentences.en: And how can you use this next six months to really make sure that by this time next year, you're getting one, two, three, maybe even four, yes, please,

sentences.en: we'd like you to tell us more about yourself opportunities.

sentences.en: That's all you need.
sentences.zh: 这就是你所需要的全部。

sentences.en: If it's your time and it's the right course for you and I don't know,
sentences.zh: 如果时机到了，这就是适合你的课程，而且我不知道，

sentences.zh: 阳光正照在正确的方向上，一切似乎都很顺利，去面试的路上交通灯全是绿灯。

sentences.en: And you're able to bring your A game to that interview day, then that's all you need.

sentences.en: You know, you do just need one university to allow you to have an interview, to be able to demonstrate why this is a great fit for you,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你只需要一所大学给你面试机会，让你能够展示为什么这非常适合你，

sentences.en: why this course is great for you and how it is your time and you're ready for the next step.

sentences.en: So please be kind to yourselves.

sentences.zh: 也请善待并支持你周围的人，因为这段时间可能会让人非常受挫。

sentences.en: And it's also it's OK to be sad for yourself and excited for others or vice versa.

sentences.en: It's OK to be really sad that your colleagues or friends might not be getting interviews, but also be really proud and excited about your own interviews that you have lined up.
sentences.zh: 为你的同事或朋友可能没有收到面试邀请而感到难过，但同时为你自己已经安排好的面试感到自豪和兴奋，这是没关系的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, please do stay kind.

sentences.en: then you can check out details in the show notes or by going to the link in any of my social media bios.

sentences.en: But yeah, thank you for joining me.

sentences.en: Do let me know, won't you, how you get on with your outcomes.

sentences.zh: 记住，我会和你一起再过一遍这些内容。

sentences.en: Remember to join us for the free Compassionate Q&A sessions, which will be running across my socials.
sentences.zh: 记得参加我们的免费“同情心问答”环节，这些环节将在我的社交媒体上进行。

sentences.en: You can find me at Dr. Marianne Trent pretty much everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你几乎可以在任何地方找到我，搜索Dr. Marianne Trent。

sentences.en: On Monday, the 13th of March, 2023, 7.30pm.
Monday, the 17th of April, 2023, 7.30pm.
And Tuesday, the 2nd of May, 2023, also at 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 以及2023年5月2日，星期二，同样在晚上7:30。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for joining me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的加入。

sentences.en: Like, subscribe, do all those good things, tell your friends about us.
sentences.zh: 点赞、订阅，做所有那些好事，告诉你的朋友们关于我们的事。

sentences.en: And I'll look forward to catching up with you for the next podcast episode, which will be coming to you from 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我期待在下一期播客中与你相见，节目将于周一早上6点发布。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Thanks for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的钱，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家Dr. Marianne Trent，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One2Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员计划和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得Sophie的奖励，以及我独家提供的额外支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组策划会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时在这里。
